title: npm run fast guard step takes 339s on a 4-file change
body:
Evidence 2026-11-16: npm run fast in .krn/worktrees/org-account (4 changed files, 3 tests) printed 'guard 338736ms' and 'got a test slot after 1028.2s'; total 1380s (log: .krn/runs/lead/t-3kpq3tm-fast.log). Host load 25-60 with 3 lanes + S7 verify.
Outcome: npm run fast on a 4-file change finishes guard in under 30s at the median and the slot wait is bounded (guard runs outside the slot or proportional to the diff).
Proof: a timing test or fast-check log on a 4-file change prints guard < 30000ms.
Files: scripts/fast-check.ts, scripts/lib/slot-lock.ts
